name: apidrifter-example-nestjs
description: Minimal NestJS app whose OpenAPI document is generated by @nestjs/swagger, for trying apidrifter.

scripts.spec: npm run build && node dist/export-spec.js > openapi.json
scripts.check: npx -y apidrifter run http://localhost:3000/openapi.json --base-url http://localhost:3000 --format markdown
